title: Paseo
description: Discover Paseo workspaces and agents by project, repository, branch, and name; read recent agent messages; and open them or draft or send prompts through paseo:// links. Use catalog ids with their serverId. Workspace message reads include several agents. A sent prompt through a link is a handoff, not proof of delivery or completion.
guidance: Most Paseo requests take several steps. For a vague workspace description, call list_workspaces with one distinctive project, repository, or branch fragment, then select a row by its metadata; ask which if several fit. Use that row’s id and serverId together. A workspace may contain multiple agents: use read_workspace_messages for a workspace summary, or list_agents and read_agent_messages when one session matters. Before prompting an existing agent, identify it with list_agents and use its id and serverId together. Say which agent you picked and the gist of the prompt. Use send_agent_prompt only when the user asked to send, otherwise draft_agent_prompt. For new work that belongs to no existing agent, use new_agent. Read the relevant transcript before composing a follow-up when its context matters. Never guess an id or reuse one from memory. Catalog rows may be stale until Paseo is opened again; if nothing matches, try a different fragment or offer open_history.
setup: Install Paseo and open it at least once: it publishes the workspace and agent catalog while the app has been in the foreground, so anything created since then is missing until it opens again.
To let the send action actually send, turn on Settings, General, Send prompts from links in Paseo. With it off Paseo drafts the prompt instead, and EVA cannot tell the two apart.

This package needs a Paseo build with the repository catalog column and assistant messages provider. Recent-message reads also need the app process running and the target host connected. An unavailable transcript is returned as a notice row.

tool.name: list_workspaces
tool.title: List Paseo workspaces
tool.description: Find a Paseo workspace before opening or reading it. Never guess a workspaceId. Rows are most recently active first: id, serverId, name, project, repository (Git remote host/path without credentials), branch, status, agentCount, and lastActivityAt. q matches one case-insensitive substring in one column, not a phrase or fuzzy search. Try a distinctive project, repository, or branch fragment; if none matches, try another fragment or list without q at a higher limit. If one row fits, use its id and serverId; if several fit, ask which one using project, repository, name, and branch. Catalog rows may be stale until Paseo opens again and cover at most 100 workspaces.

q.description: One case-insensitive fragment of name, project, repository, branch, status, or an id. Not a phrase search.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 100 (Paseo defaults to 25). Raise it when listing without q.

tool.name: list_agents
tool.title: List Paseo agents
tool.description: Find a Paseo agent session without guessing its id. Rows are most recently active first: id, serverId, workspaceId, name, provider, status, and lastActivityAt. If the user identifies a workspace, find it with list_workspaces, then pass its id and serverId here. A workspace can have several agents; ask which one when the request needs a specific agent and several fit. q matches one case-insensitive fragment, not a phrase. Catalog rows may be stale until Paseo opens again and cover at most 200 unarchived top-level agents.

workspaceId.description: The id of a list_workspaces row; lists only that workspace's agents. Exact match.

serverId.description: Host from the same list_workspaces row; scope the workspace id to this host.

q.description: One word or fragment, matched case-insensitively as a substring of any single column (name, provider, status, or ids). Not a phrase search.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 100 (Paseo defaults to 25). Raise it when listing without q.

tool.name: read_workspace_messages
tool.title: Read recent Paseo workspace messages
tool.description: Read recent messages across the selected workspace's active top-level agents, newest first. First find the workspace with list_workspaces; use id as workspaceId and its serverId from the same row. Each message names its agent and has kind, time, and clipped text. Paseo reads up to six recently active agents. A kind=notice row means Paseo could not read the transcript; report the notice instead of inventing a summary. Paseo must be running with a connected host. This is a read, not a prompt send.

workspaceId.description: The id of the selected list_workspaces row.

serverId.description: The serverId of that same workspace row.

limit.description: Maximum messages, newest first; defaults to 10.

tool.name: read_agent_messages
tool.title: Read recent Paseo agent messages
tool.description: Read one Paseo agent's recent user, assistant, and tool-summary messages, newest first. Find the agent with list_agents and use its id and serverId from the same row. If a workspace has several plausible agents, ask which one unless the user wants workspace-wide activity; use read_workspace_messages for that. A kind=notice row means Paseo could not read the transcript. Paseo must be running with a connected host. This is a read, not a prompt send.

agentId.description: The id of the selected list_agents row.

serverId.description: The serverId of that same agent row.

limit.description: Maximum messages, newest first; defaults to 10.

tool.name: new_agent
tool.title: Start a new agent
tool.description: Start new work in Paseo: open its New workspace screen with the prompt in the composer. The user chooses the project, model, and isolation and taps Send; nothing is sent by this action. It cannot add work to an existing workspace or agent; for that, find the agent with list_agents and use draft_agent_prompt or send_agent_prompt. Catalog rows carry no projectId or directory, so omit projectId and dir unless the user supplies one. A successful EVA receipt proves only that Paseo opened.

serverId.description: Paseo host (daemon serverId), such as the serverId of a list_workspaces row on the host the user wants. Omit to use the host of the last opened workspace, or the only configured host.

dir.description: Absolute directory on the host to preselect as the project root.

receipts.success: Paseo opened its New workspace screen with the prompt in the composer. The user has to choose a project and send it; EVA does not observe that.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://new links.

tool.name: open_agent
tool.title: Open an agent
tool.description: Open an existing Paseo agent session so the user can read it. Take agentId and serverId from the same list_agents row. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff; Paseo shows its own error for an unknown agent or host, which EVA does not see.

agentId.description: The id of a list_agents row.

serverId.description: Host (serverId) from the same list row as the id. When omitted, Paseo uses the host of the last opened workspace or the only configured host, which may be the wrong one when there are several.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent. Paseo shows an error itself if the agent or host is unknown.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: draft_agent_prompt
tool.title: Draft a follow-up for an agent
tool.description: Open a Paseo agent session with the prompt appended to its composer, unsent, so the user can review and tap Send. Take agentId and serverId from the same list_agents row. Use send_agent_prompt to deliver without a tap. A successful EVA receipt proves only that Paseo opened the agent.

agentId.description: The id of a list_agents row.

serverId.description: Host (serverId) from the same list row as the id. When omitted, Paseo uses the host of the last opened workspace or the only configured host, which may be the wrong one when there are several.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent with the prompt in its composer. The user has to send it; EVA does not observe that.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: send_agent_prompt
tool.title: Send a follow-up to an agent
tool.description: Open a Paseo agent session and ask Paseo to send the prompt to it immediately. Take agentId and serverId from the same list_agents row. Paseo only sends when its setting “Send prompts from links” is on; otherwise it places the prompt in the composer unsent and tells the user why. EVA cannot tell which happened: a successful receipt proves only the handoff, not delivery or completion of the agent's work.

agentId.description: The id of a list_agents row.

serverId.description: Host (serverId) from the same list row as the id. When omitted, Paseo uses the host of the last opened workspace or the only configured host, which may be the wrong one when there are several.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the agent and was asked to send the prompt. Delivery depends on Paseo's “Send prompts from links” setting and the host being online; EVA does not verify it.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://agent links.

tool.name: open_workspace
tool.title: Open a workspace
tool.description: Open a Paseo workspace, optionally on one agent or terminal tab. Take workspaceId and serverId from the same list_workspaces row; when the user names a workspace, search for it first rather than guessing an id. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff; Paseo shows its own error for an unknown workspace or host, which EVA does not see.

workspaceId.description: The id of a list_workspaces row.

serverId.description: Host (serverId) from the same list row as the id. When omitted, Paseo uses the host of the last opened workspace or the only configured host, which may be the wrong one when there are several.

agentId.description: Agent tab to focus: the id of a list_agents row in this workspace.

terminalId.description: Terminal tab to focus, only when the user supplies its id. Ignored when agentId is given.

receipts.success: Paseo opened the workspace. Paseo shows an error itself if the workspace or host is unknown.
receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://workspace links.

tool.name: open_history
tool.title: Open agent history
tool.description: Open Paseo's History screen listing recent agent sessions across hosts, for the user to browse. Takes no arguments. To find a specific agent or workspace yourself, use list_agents or list_workspaces. A successful EVA receipt proves only the handoff to Paseo.

receipts.handlerMissing: Paseo is not installed or this version cannot open paseo://sessions links.
